operative_text:
Section 1 (R.C. 9.68): That section 9.68 of the Revised Code is hereby repealed.
Section 2 (R.C. 9.68): That the version of section 9.68 of the Revised Code scheduled to take effect on December 28, 2019, is hereby repealed on December 28, 2019.
